evidence_items.explanation: The university describes researchers concluding that current LLMs already constitute AGI using conversational and expert-performance evidence. This is material counterevidence, but it neither establishes broad agreement nor isolates scaling as the cause.

unresolved_gaps: The recovered evaluations do not comprehensively cover leading systems through March 16, 2026.
Credible researchers apply different thresholds to broad human-level competence and reach opposing conclusions.
The available evidence does not isolate the contribution of scaling from other changes in training and system design.
